title: OmniHarness-RSI: Modality-Aware Harness Evolution for Omnimodal Understanding
title_zh: OmniHarness-RSI：面向全模态理解的模态感知智能体工作流演化
abstract_en: Recent advances in harness-based recursive self-improvement (RSI) have improved video understanding by evolving executable agent workflows without updating foundation model parameters. However, extending this paradigm to omnimodal understanding remains challenging, as the heterogeneous and interdependent nature of multimodal perception and reasoning creates a complex evolution space, making targeted harness optimization difficult. To address these challenges, we propose OmniHarness-RSI, a modality-aware framework for evolving agent harnesses. Specifically, we factorize the evolution space into three capability dimensions: modality routing and collaboration, modality-aware evidence localization, and modality-specific perception. Based on this factorization, we construct a Factorized-Harness Agent integrating specialized perception experts and audio-video retrieval tools. We further introduce modality-guided harness evolution, which identifies deficiencies through structured modality-capability attribution and refines corresponding harness strategies through interactive code revisions and execution feedback. Validation-guided selection and held-out evaluation assess generalization within and across datasets. Experiments on WorldSense, Daily-Omni, and OmniVideoBench demonstrate test accuracy improvements of 8.86, 8.13, and 6.23 percentage points, respectively, consistently outperforming modality-agnostic RSI. The evolved harnesses also demonstrate cross-dataset transfer without adaptation, while reducing planner calls and viewed frames.
abstract_zh: 基于智能体执行框架（harness）的递归自我改进（RSI）可以在不更新基础模型参数的情况下，通过改进可执行工作流来提升视频理解能力。然而，在全模态理解中，不同模态的感知方式各异，感知与推理又相互依赖，使工作流难以有针对性地优化。OmniHarness-RSI 将演化空间分解为三个能力维度：模态路由与协作、模态感知的证据定位，以及模态专属感知。基于这一分解，Factorized-Harness Agent 集成了专门的感知专家和音视频检索工具。框架通过结构化的模态与能力归因定位短板，再借助交互式代码修订和执行反馈优化相应策略，并通过验证集选择与留出集评估检验同一数据集内和跨数据集的泛化能力。在 WorldSense、Daily-Omni 和 OmniVideoBench 上，测试准确率分别提升 8.86、8.13 和 6.23 个百分点，均优于不区分模态的 RSI。演化后的工作流无需额外适配即可跨数据集迁移，同时减少规划器调用次数和查看的视频帧数。
